newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Belgrade hands Zagreb dual citizenship treaty.
newsitem.headline: Belgrade hands Zagreb dual citizenship treaty.

text.p: Yugoslavia has sent Croatia a draft treaty offering residents of Eastern Slavonia dual citizenship when Croatian rule is restored in the enclave.
Western diplomats in the region have been urging such a treaty, saying it would help to avert an exodus of frighted ethnic Serbs before the Croatian take-over.

Eastern Slavonia was one of three areas where local Serbs seized power in a 1991 revolt against Croatia's independence from Yugoslavia. It is now under U.N. supervision and will revert to Croatian government rule with guarantees for minority rights after elections on April 13.
The official news agency Tanjug said a draft treaty on dual citizenship was sent to Zagreb on Friday but gave no details of its terms.
